title: In-context approval actions in NodeDetailPanel
description:
Wire approve/reject buttons into the NodeDetailPanel for approval steps that are still pending. Operator can approve or reject a workflow step directly from the DAG view without navigating to /approvals.

**File:** `dashboard/src/components/workflows/dag/NodeDetailPanel.tsx` (modify)

**When an approval step has status `approval_required`:**
- Show prominent Approve (green) and Reject (red) buttons
- Optional comment textarea before submitting
- On approve/reject: call existing `useApproveJob(jobId)` / `useRejectJob(jobId)` mutations (the approval is by job ID — get jobId from the step's metadata/context)
- Show loading state during mutation
- On success: invalidate run queries so DAG updates, show success toast
- On error: show error message inline

**Mapping:** Each workflow step that's a job step has a `jobId` in the run's step data. Approval steps trigger a job that goes to `approval_required` state. The jobId is available in `run.steps[i].jobId` or `run.steps[i].metadata.jobId`.

Reuse existing approval mutation hooks from `useApprovals` or `useJobs`.
definitionOfDone: Approve/Reject buttons visible for pending approval steps
Run queries invalidated on success for live DAG update

implementationPlan.description:
Add in-context approval UI to `NodeDetailPanel.tsx` for approval steps with pending/waiting status.

Modify the approval section to add:
- `useState<string>('')` for comment textarea
- `useApproveStep()` mutation from `useApprovals` (POST `/workflows/{wId}/runs/{rId}/steps/{sId}/approve`)
- `useRejectJob()` or similar rejection mutation
- Approve button (variant=primary, green styling) and Reject button (variant=danger)
- Both disabled while mutation `isPending`
- Comment Textarea (optional, placeholder: 'Add a comment...')
- On success: `queryClient.invalidateQueries(['workflow-runs'])` to refresh DAG
- On error: inline red error message below buttons

Job ID extraction: `runStep?.config?.jobId` or `runStep?.output?.jobId`. Fall back to step ID for step-level approval via `useApproveStep({ workflowId, runId, stepId })`.

Only show buttons when `runStep?.status` is `waiting` or `blocked` (approval_required mapped status). Hide for resolved steps.

SECURITY: Comment string passed directly to API (backend must sanitize). No HTML rendering of comment. Mutation uses authenticated API client with X-API-Key header. Confirm dialog not needed (approve is explicit button click).
implementationPlan.note: Wired in-context approval into ApprovalDetail: useApproveJob/useRejectJob for job-based approval (extracts jobId from config/output), useApproveStep for step-level fallback. Added comment Textarea, loading spinners on buttons, success/error messages, invalidates workflow-runs queries on success. Removed onApprove/onReject callback props (now handled internally). ApprovalDetail receives run prop for workflowId/runId access.

implementationPlan.description: Verify `node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit`. Test that approval mutation imports resolve from useApprovals hook.
implementationPlan.note: tsc --noEmit clean. All approval mutation imports resolve correctly.
